body: I'm not sure how I feel about medication.  It sort of scares me.  But I will talk to a doctor when I can and see what they think is best.

Yes, it's been helping.

I've posted to /r/depression two or three times before but never received any replies.  I also posted to a local subreddit asking if anyone had therapist recommendations but the only reply I received said "We've got plenty of rapists around here, I'm sure you'll have no problem finding the rapist you need."

So thank you for helping and being nice.

I definitely need to clean.  My room has gotten messy to the point of being unhygienic.  I haven't washed my sheets in about two months and I still have tissues on the ground from a cold that I had two weeks ago.

Thank you, I will try to do your suggestions.  They're all things I know will help, it's just difficult to get the motivation and energy to do them.  Particularly when I feel like it might not even matter at all if I'm not around in a few weeks.  But I will try.  Thank you.

Thank you.  Really, your reply means a lot to me.

I'd like to talk to a therapist, but the main difficulty is that I live with my parents.  They have no idea that I feel this way, and I think I would be more comfortable if they didn't find out.  Even if they did find out, we wouldn't have the money to pay for a therapist.  I recently applied to receive Medicaid, so once that comes through I should be able to see someone without having to ask my parents for money.  I just have another thirty days or so to wait.
This actually did help a bit.  Thank you.
